title: Copper Squeeze Grows as Key LME Spread Hits Highest Since 2021
summary: Spot copper prices are surging above later-dated futures on the London Metal Exchange, in a condition known as backwardation that’s a hallmark of a deepening squeeze on supply.

title: Kalshi Says It Does Not Operate Like a Sports Book
summary:
Kalshi and other prediction markets are coming under more pressure from multiple states and regulators. New York City and New York State are both investigating the exchange. 
Robert DeNault, Kalshi head of enforcement, says the company follows strict CFTC regulations and monitors the platform 24/7 looking for insider trading and suspicious activity. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Rise Ahead of More Data; US Hits China with 100% Tariffs on Drones | Bloomberg Brief 08/14/26
summary: US equity futures waver after stocks notched a fresh record high ahead of retail sales and consumer sentiment data. Oil climbs as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the US will announce unprecedented plans for Iran's "economic isolation" next week. The Trump administration imposes levies of as much as 100% on imported drones and components, further decoupling from drone supply chains with China. OpenAI is said to be on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion. Stephanie Guild, CIO of Robinhood, looks ahead to more data following the latest signs of cooling inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Colombia Bond Market Perks Up After De la Espriella’s Election
summary: Colombia’s local corporate bond sales are rebounding after four years in the doldrums as the election of a market-friendly government stokes investor demand for local assets and triggers a drop in sovereign yields.

title: Tyson to Close More Beef Plants as Cattle Shortage Drags On

title: Kenya Eyes Eurobond, Debt Swaps in $5.4 Billion Financing Plan

title: Treasuries Rise as Weak Retail Sales Dampen Fed Rate-Hike Expectations

title: Zambia Halts Vote Count, Citing Unrest as Opposition Cries Foul

title: Dollar Slides to May Low as Weak Retail Sales Dim Rate Bets
summary: The dollar fell to the lowest since May after an unexpectedly weak reading of US retail sales pushed traders to further pare back their expectations for an interest-rate hike this year.

title: EdgeConneX Seeks $2.5 Billion Bank Pledge for Data Center Power
summary: EQT-backed EdgeConneX Inc. is asking banks to guarantee as much as $2.5 billion in power costs, joining a wave of data center builders turning to new financing playbooks to fuel growth.

title: Gold Steadies Above $4,300 as Traders Weigh Fed Rate-Hike Path
summary: Gold recovered from an early bout of profit-taking to trade steady above $4,300 an ounce, with investors weighing the likely path of US monetary policy after tame US inflation data.

title: Radiant World Said to Sell Aluminum Stockpile to STG Group
summary: Metals trader Radiant World agreed to sell a stockpile of aluminum to STG Group, according to people familiar with the matter, in a move that will bring in liquidity to the firm.

title: White Sugar Rally Boosts Refining as Supply Outlook Tightens
